contract: artifacts/control-room/DESIGN.md: preserve the existing hero and portfolio; replace only the discipline strip with coordinated nodes, Pixel workstation and illustrative code playback. No execution, new dependencies or external service.

accessibility.evidence: Native node buttons retain labels, aria-pressed, description associations, focus states, keyboard and touch interaction. Axe passed on the feature. Animated characters are aria-hidden; a separate completed-code representation has no character live announcements. Pause/resume and keyboard scrolling are present. Dynamic reduced motion displays complete code and zero animations.

responsive.evidence: All six rendered sizes fit without page overflow. 1440 through 768 use four readable nodes; 390 and 360 use a 2x2 diagram. Code remains 13px and can scroll within the screen. Caption and explanation space is reserved across selections. Existing portrait/hero captures at 1440 and 390 are pixel-identical to the prior lab review.

loading.reason: The local data and SVG artwork are synchronously bundled with the existing homepage; this display performs no asynchronous data fetch.

empty.evidence: The empty buffer is an intentional short typing start/gap with a cursor; completed code remains available to assistive technology. Reselecting a node mounts its initial empty buffer, verified before the next character can arrive.

partial.evidence: Real-time review captured character-by-character text and typing hands. The keyboard pause test freezes exactly that partial buffer, then resumes. Hidden-document and offscreen tests show an unchanged buffer and zero pending display timers.

success.evidence: The full example holds for reading, then moves to a second example within the selected discipline. Native playback tests verify the real reading interval, loop and clean restart. Every discipline selects the expected full source and matching description/path.

error.reason: No code is evaluated and there is no user input, network call or fallible external service. Example strings and artwork are deterministic local data validated by the four-discipline tests.

permission.reason: No device, backend, shell, privileged operation or external application is accessed by this UI.
